# Routeplane AI Gateway

> Routeplane is a neutral, multi-provider **AI Gateway** — an SRE-grade, OpenAI-compatible proxy in one Rust binary, in front of 15 LLM providers. Point any OpenAI (or Anthropic) SDK at it: only the base URL and the key change. It adds declarative routing with fallback/retry/hedging, per-provider circuit breaking, guardrails and PII masking, budgets & rate limits, response caching, and an enterprise upgrade path (sovereign data-residency routing, a tamper-evident audit ledger, and an agentic-security MCP gateway).

This file is a machine-readable overview for AI agents and LLMs. The authoritative contract is the OpenAPI 3.1 spec (`openapi.yaml` in this repo), rendered at https://docs.routeplane.ai. A longer companion, `llms-full.txt`, includes the per-endpoint request/response reference.

## Authentication

Present a Routeplane virtual key (always `rp_`-prefixed). Two equivalent forms:

- `Authorization: Bearer rp_...` — the SDK-compatibility form. This is what every stock OpenAI SDK sends, so pointing an OpenAI SDK at Routeplane needs only a `base_url` change plus your virtual key as the API key.
- `x-routeplane-api-key: rp_...` — the branded primary header.

Both resolve through the same constant-time lookup. A non-`rp_` Bearer value (e.g. a provider key like `sk-...`) is **never** accepted and never forwarded — provider credentials are resolved server-side from the virtual key. Missing/invalid credentials return `401` with the OpenAI error envelope (`code: invalid_api_key`).

## Base URLs

- **Cloud**: `https://api.routeplane.ai` — OpenAI-compatible routes live under `/v1` (e.g. `https://api.routeplane.ai/v1/chat/completions`).
- **Self-hosted**: `https://<your-gateway-host>` — same paths; the open-source gateway is a single Rust binary you run yourself.

## Providers

23 provider integrations, selected (or chained) via `x-routeplane-provider`: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini, Azure OpenAI, Mistral, Cohere, Amazon Bedrock, Groq, DeepSeek, Together AI, Fireworks AI, xAI (Grok), OpenRouter, Perplexity, Cerebras, SambaNova, Nebius AI Studio, Anyscale, Novita AI, Moonshot AI, DeepInfra, a generic OpenAI-compatible `self_hosted` adapter (vLLM / Ollama / LocalAI), plus a built-in `local` moderation source. A comma-separated value like `openai,anthropic` is a fallback chain.

## Core endpoints

OpenAI-compatible inference (Community, open source):

- `POST /v1/chat/completions` — chat completions, buffered or streaming (SSE), with tool calling and multimodal parts. The `model` field may name an operator-defined **combo** (a saved routing chain).
- `POST /v1/messages` — native Anthropic Messages surface (same pipeline; streaming not supported here — use chat/completions).
- `POST /v1/embeddings` — OpenAI-compatible embeddings.
- `GET /v1/models`, `GET /v1/models/{id}` — model discovery (curated catalog + combos; combos have `owned_by: "routeplane"`).
- `POST /v1/moderations` — content moderation (incl. in-process `local` source).
- `POST /v1/rerank` — Cohere/LiteLLM-compatible reranking (RAG).
- `POST /v1/images/generations` — image generation.
- `POST /v1/audio/speech` — text-to-speech (binary audio out).
- `POST /v1/audio/transcriptions` — speech-to-text (multipart upload).
- `POST /v1/audio/translations` — audio → English text (multipart upload).
- `POST /v1/responses` — intentionally unsupported; returns a typed `501` pointing to chat/completions.

Observability & system (Community):

- `POST /v1/feedback` — attach a quality score to a request trace (by `x-routeplane-trace-id`).
- `POST /v1/cache/purge` — advance the authenticated canonical tenant's exact-cache purge generation, optionally for one namespace.
- `GET /v1/logs` — recent request logs, scoped to your own keys.
- `GET /analytics`, `GET /analytics/latency` — recent usage events + latency percentiles.
- `GET /status` — operational snapshot (no auth).
- `GET /metrics` — protected Prometheus text exposition (operator credential required by default).
- `GET /healthz` — liveness probe (no auth).

Enterprise (commercial):

Semantic-cache machinery is evaluation-gated and fail-closed/dark until a
production verifier is provisioned and the ADR-105 held-out plus
production-shadow bars pass; entitlement alone does not arm answer serving.

- `GET /v1/prompts/{ref}` (+ `/render`, `/completions`) — versioned prompt registry.
- `POST /v1/mcp/tool-result/inspect` — agentic security: inspect a tool result before it re-enters the model context.
- `POST /v1/mcp/tool-call/authorize` — agentic security: default-deny tool-call authorization.
- `POST /v1/mcp/run/step` — agentic security: account one agent-run iteration against its breakers.

## Request headers (all `x-routeplane-*`)

- `x-routeplane-api-key` — virtual key (`rp_`-prefixed). See Authentication.
- `x-routeplane-provider` — provider or comma-separated fallback chain (route-specific default). Overridden by sovereign routing when regulated data + a residency jurisdiction apply.
- `x-routeplane-strategy` — candidate ordering: `priority` (default) | `weighted` | `cost` | `latency`.
- `x-routeplane-residency` — requested data-residency jurisdiction (e.g. `IN`); enforced as a hard region lock only when the request also carries regulated personal data.
- `x-routeplane-config` — routing/guardrails JSON envelope, or a saved-config reference `cfg_<id>` (Enterprise; named combos are the Community path to saved chains).
- `x-routeplane-metadata` — JSON object of scalars addressable from routing conditions as `metadata.<key>`.
- `x-routeplane-use-case` — business-process label for cost attribution in the FinOps reads.
- `x-routeplane-currency` — display currency for cost annotations (e.g. `INR`); canonical accounting stays micro-USD.
- `x-routeplane-timeout-ms` — per-request deadline override (narrow-only; MIN-folded with the server deadline).
- `x-routeplane-pii-mode` — `tokenize` requests reversible tokenization instead of irreversible masking (Enterprise; degrades loudly).
- `x-routeplane-output-mask` — opt-in output-masking annotation (baseline response masking runs regardless).
- `x-routeplane-cache-control` — `no-store` bypasses the response cache for this request.
- `x-routeplane-idempotency-key` — idempotency key for safe retries (standard `Idempotency-Key` also accepted).
- `x-routeplane-cohort` — explicit A/B cohort key for prompt-variant selection.

Useful response headers include `x-routeplane-provider` (which provider served it), `x-routeplane-trace-id` (correlation id for `POST /v1/feedback`), and `x-routeplane-cache` (`hit`/`miss`/`bypass`/`semantic-hit`).

## Errors

All `4xx`/`5xx` bodies use the OpenAI error envelope, extended with Routeplane-branded codes (`routeplane_rate_limit_exceeded`, `routeplane_budget_exceeded`, `endpoint_not_supported`, ...). Notable statuses: `401` invalid key, `402` budget exhausted, `422` sovereign routing refusal (no jurisdiction-resident provider), `429` rate limited, `446` guardrails denied (per-check results under `x_routeplane.check_results`), `503` capacity shed. Assert on `error.code`, not the bare status.

## SDKs & tooling

- **Python** — `pip install routeplane` → `from routeplane import Routeplane` (also `AsyncRouteplane`, and a `headers()` helper for use with the stock OpenAI/LangChain/LlamaIndex/CrewAI SDKs). https://pypi.org/project/routeplane
- **TypeScript / JavaScript** — `npm i @routeplane/sdk` → `import { Routeplane } from '@routeplane/sdk'` (a typed core client lives at `@routeplane/sdk/core`, with a `createHeaders()` helper for the OpenAI / Vercel AI SDKs). https://www.npmjs.com/package/@routeplane/sdk
- **CLI** — `npm i -g @routeplane/cli` (installs the `rp` binary) or `npx @routeplane/cli status`. https://www.npmjs.com/package/@routeplane/cli
- **MCP Server** — `npx -y @routeplane/mcp-server` (env `ROUTEPLANE_API_KEY`, `ROUTEPLANE_BASE_URL`) exposes the gateway to MCP-capable agents. https://www.npmjs.com/package/@routeplane/mcp-server

## Quick examples

Python (native SDK):

```python
from routeplane import Routeplane

client = Routeplane(
    api_key="rp_your_gateway_key",
    provider="openai,anthropic",   # fallback chain
    strategy="cost",               # cheapest eligible provider first
    residency="IN",                # keep Indian PII in-region
    use_case="support-bot",        # FinOps cost attribution
)

resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o-mini",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}],
)
print(resp.choices[0].message.content)
```

Python (any OpenAI SDK — only base_url + key change):

```python
import openai

client = openai.OpenAI(
    api_key="rp_your_gateway_key",
    base_url="https://api.routeplane.ai/v1",
    default_headers={"x-routeplane-api-key": "rp_your_gateway_key"},
)
resp = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="gpt-4o-mini",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello!"}],
)
```

curl:

```bash
curl https://api.routeplane.ai/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "content-type: application/json" \
  -H "authorization: Bearer rp_your_gateway_key" \
  -H "x-routeplane-provider: openai,anthropic" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Hello!"}]}'
```
